header.title: RealtyBoss vs. the rest
header.subtitle: How we stack up against Follow Up Boss, kvCORE / BoldTrail, Lofty, BoomTown and Sierra Interactive on AI, dialer, e-sign, team workflows, and Chinese-market support — at a fraction of the price.

work_vs_remind.h2_pre: Every other CRM reminds you to do the work.
work_vs_remind.h2_highlight: RealtyBoss does the work for you.
work_vs_remind.body_pre: Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Lofty and the rest are brilliant at telling you what to do next — a task list, a “this lead is hot” alert, a drip that fires on schedule. But the calling, texting, emailing, researching and follow-up is still on you. RealtyBoss ships an AI team that actually
work_vs_remind.body_post: — so the work happens while you’re sitting with clients.
reminder_items: Creates a task: “Call this lead” — you still make the call
Alerts you a lead went cold — you write the win-back
Fires a drip on a timer — generic, not a real reply
Surfaces a CMA tool — you assemble the comps yourself
work_vs_remind.does_title: RealtyBoss — an AI team that does it
does_items: Answers & qualifies new leads by text and email — autonomously
Drafts and sends the win-back reply in your voice
Runs an AI-grounded CMA with real cited comps on command
Builds the offer, reviews the contract, books the showing for you

highlights.title: An AI team that does the work
highlights.body: Others remind you to call, text, and follow up. RealtyBoss's AI assistants answer leads, draft and send replies, run CMAs, and book showings on your behalf — the work gets done, not just queued.

highlights.title: Half the price of enterprise CRMs
highlights.body: $79–$199/month covers what BoomTown, kvCORE, and Lofty charge $500–$1,500/month for. No setup fee. No mandatory IDX-website upsell.

highlights.title: Bilingual + WeChat ecosystem
highlights.body: Chinese-speaking agents and clients are a first-class audience: 中文 templates, WeChat + Xiaohongshu paths, Advisor sales-model. Nobody else does this.

highlights.title: Modern stack = faster shipping
highlights.body: AI-grounded CMAs with real cited comps, a one-command AI team, inbound transaction-email auto-import — shipped in weeks, not quarters. The pace difference compounds.

cta.heading: Stop managing a CRM. Start running a team.
cta.body: Most legacy CRMs charge $500+/month to hand you a longer to-do list. RealtyBoss gives you an AI team that works the list for you — answering leads, sending replies, and running deals — at a fraction of the price.

footnote: Comparison data reflects publicly available product pages and customer reviews as of the page’s last update. Inside Real Estate has consolidated kvCORE and BoomTown into BoldTrail; LionDesk was discontinued in September 2025, so it is no longer listed. “Partial” on AI rows means the tool drafts or suggests and the agent still reviews and sends. Competitor pricing varies by team size + add-ons. We don’t claim every edge case; if something looks off please reach out.
